chunks: The pigeon was mentioned in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he said: Keep them in your homes, for indeed they are beloved — the supplication of Noah (peace be upon him) reached them, and they are the most comforting thing in homes.

key_terms.آنس: Most comforting/companionable — superlative of uns (intimacy/companionship), indicating they bring the greatest sense of calm and familiarity
key_terms.الحمام: Pigeon/dove — the bird singled out in Prophetic traditions regarding Noah's Ark
key_terms.دعوة نوح: The supplication of Noah (AS) — referring to the lasting blessing Noah prayed upon the pigeon after the flood

ai.seo_question: Why are pigeons recommended to keep in homes according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) endorsed keeping pigeons in homes, citing the spiritual distinction bestowed upon them by Prophet Noah's blessed supplication. According to Islamic tradition, when Noah's Ark came to rest after the great flood, the Prophet Noah (AS) prayed a blessing over the pigeon that had been dispatched and returned — thus conferring a lasting divine favor upon this bird. The hadith frames this recommendation in spiritual terms: the pigeon is 'beloved' (mahbuba) in the divine sense, and the term 'anas' (companionship/comfort) conveys the intimate, reassuring presence these birds bring to a household.
